findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "pool_term" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: What does a pool, billiards or snooker word mean? 36 terms and 27 names of games in the family, one line each - screw, stun, throw, half-ball, snooker, bank, ki…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
